description: Returns one slide of one deck, with the deck summary, by deck id and slide number. Use it to look up a slide you already know, such as one named in a get_deck or search_slides result; use get_deck for the whole deck. The result has deck (the summary) and the slide fields from get_deck, plus position ("n of slide count") and page_url, the slide on the deck page. Slides belong to the companies that made them; cite the deck source_url when you use one.

deck_id.description: A deck id from list_decks or search_slides, such as "airbnb".

n.description: The slide number, counted from 1, as n in get_deck.

name: get_slide
title: Get a slide
